§6Blast Furnace Extension§f

§aFree speed. No extra fuel. What's not to like?§f

Plop this on top of your §bBlast Furnace§f and it runs 3× faster. Same fuel cost, same recipes, just faster processing. It activates the moment you place it, no configuration needed at all.

Craft it at a table from copper plates, firebrick, and steel grates. One extension per furnace is the limit, but that 3× boost makes a huge difference for alloy production when you're waiting on steel.

§ePS:§f Even with the extension, a single blast furnace will bottleneck you eventually. Build multiples when you need real throughput.
